OURA.products_services: Oura Ring, sleep and activity tracking, readiness scores, personalized health insights, mobile app integration
OURA.description_ja: Oura Inc.は、先進的なウェアラブル機器を通じて個人の健康増進に取り組む、有力なヘルステクノロジー企業である。主力製品のOura Ringは、睡眠、活動量、コンディションを計測し、利用者の健康管理を支援する。
OURA.products_services_ja: Oura Ring、睡眠・活動量の計測、コンディションスコア、パーソナライズされた健康インサイト、モバイルアプリ連携

0002089787.description: RainRock Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an operating business. As a shell company with no commercial operations of its own, it seeks a target business to take public, typically within a set timeframe.
0002089787.products_services: No operating products or services; the company's sole purpose is to identify, evaluate, and complete a business combination with a privately held target company.
0002089787.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
0002089787.description_ja: RainRock Acquisition Corp.は、新規株式公開により資金を調達し、事業会社の買収または合併を目的として設立されたブランク・チェック・カンパニー(SPAC)。自前の事業運営のないシェルカンパニーとして、定められた期間内に上場させる対象企業を探す。
0002089787.products_services_ja: 事業としての製品・サービスはなし。唯一の目的は、非公開の対象企業を特定・評価し、企業結合を完了すること。

EMAC.description: Essential Minerals Acquisition Corp. is a special purpose acquisition company formed to identify and combine with a business in the critical minerals sector. The company intends to leverage its capital and management expertise to pursue a target that supports the supply chain for minerals essential to the energy transition and advanced manufacturing.
EMAC.products_services: As a blank check company, Essential Minerals Acquisition Corp. does not currently offer products or services; its primary activity is seeking and completing a business combination with an operating company in the critical minerals space.
EMAC.industry: Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs) / Mining and Critical Minerals
EMAC.description_ja: Essential Minerals Acquisition Corp.。重要鉱物分野の事業との統合を目的として設立されたSPAC。資本と経営の専門性を活かし、エネルギー転換や先進製造に不可欠な鉱物のサプライチェーンを支える対象の取得を目指す。
EMAC.products_services_ja: ブランクチェック会社として現時点で製品・サービスは提供しない。主な活動は、重要鉱物分野の事業会社との企業結合の模索と完了。

0002113088.description: Graf Industrial Corp. II is a company preparing for an initial public offering, with publicly available details about its business operations limited in this context. Further information from its S-1 registration statement or official investor materials would be needed to provide a verified overview of its activities.
0002113088.products_services: Not verifiable from available information; consult the company's IPO filings or prospectus for details on its products and services.
0002113088.industry: Industrial (unverified; based on the company name, which suggests an industrial focus)
0002113088.description_ja: Graf Industrial Corp. II は新規株式公開を準備中の会社。現時点で入手可能な事業内容の公開情報は限られている。事業活動について確認できた概要を示すには、S-1 登録届出書や公式の投資家向け資料など、追加情報が必要。
0002113088.products_services_ja: 入手可能な情報では確認不可。製品・サービスの詳細は IPO 関連の届出書または目論見書を参照。

KHG.description: Kainan Holding Group Ltd is a Malaysia-based one-stop workforce and human resources management provider that sources, recruits, deploys and manages legally employed casual and skilled temporary workers for corporate customers in manufacturing, construction, and service-based industries. The company generates revenue under service contracts, billing customers monthly based on attendance-confirmed work days or hours multiplied by agreed pay rates, and also has a newer construction services revenue stream.
KHG.products_services: Workforce sourcing, recruitment, deployment and ongoing management of casual and skilled temporary workers, including onboarding, worker management and compliance support; construction services.
KHG.industry: Human resources / workforce management staffing services
KHG.description_ja: Kainan Holding Group Ltd.はマレーシアを拠点とするワンストップの人材・労務管理サービス会社。製造業、建設業、サービス業の法人顧客向けに、適法に雇用された臨時・熟練の一時雇用労働者を手配、採用、配置、管理する。サービス契約に基づき収益を得ており、顧客には出勤確認済みの労働日数または時間に合意の賃金単価を乗じた金額を毎月請求する。新たな収益源として建設サービスも展開している。
KHG.products_services_ja: 臨時・熟練一時雇用労働者の手配、採用、配置および継続的管理（オンボーディング、労働者管理、コンプライアンス支援を含む）。建設サービス。

0002118192.description: DayOne Data Centers Ltd. is a data center operator focused on developing, owning, and operating hyperscale and enterprise-grade data center campuses across the Asia-Pacific region. The company is preparing for an initial public offering to fund expansion of its capacity for cloud and AI workloads.
0002118192.products_services: Colocation services, hyperscale data center campus development, powered shell and build-to-suit facilities, and data center operations and management.
0002118192.industry: Data Center Infrastructure / Digital Infrastructure (Real Estate and Technology Services)
0002118192.description_ja: DayOne Data Centers Ltd.は、アジア太平洋地域でハイパースケールおよびエンタープライズ向けデータセンターキャンパスの開発・所有・運営に注力するデータセンター事業者。クラウドやAIワークロード向けの容量拡大資金を調達するため、新規株式公開を準備している。
0002118192.products_services_ja: コロケーションサービス、ハイパースケールデータセンターキャンパスの開発、パワードシェル及びビルド・トゥ・スーツ型施設、データセンターの運用・管理。

AGKO.description: Aggreko Inc. is the North American arm of Aggreko, a global provider of temporary power, temperature control, and water solutions for events, construction, industrial, and emergency needs. The company supplies rental generators, chillers, heaters, and related equipment with supporting services to customers across a wide range of industries.
AGKO.products_services: Temporary power generation rental, temperature control (chillers and heating), water treatment and filtration, energy solutions, and related installation, maintenance, and monitoring services
AGKO.industry: Equipment rental and temporary power/temperature control services
AGKO.description_ja: Aggreko Inc. は、世界的な仮設電源、温度管理、水処理ソリューションの提供企業 Aggreko の北米法人。イベント、建設、産業、緊急対応向けにサービスを提供する。発電機、チラー、ヒーターなどの機器と関連サービスを、幅広い業界の顧客に供給している。
AGKO.products_services_ja: 仮設発電機のレンタル、温度管理（チラーおよび加温設備）、水処理・ろ過、エネルギーソリューション、およびそれらに伴う設置、保守、監視サービス。

HCPC.description: HengHong Technology Inc. is a Cayman Islands holding company that, through its Chinese operating subsidiaries led by Hainan HengCheng Health Industrial Co., Ltd., distributes pharmaceutical products in China. Its revenue comes mainly from distributing traditional Chinese medicines and chemical medical products, plus promotion and marketing services for one related-party customer that it ceased providing starting May 2025.
HCPC.products_services: Distribution of traditional Chinese medicines (e.g., cold, flu and cough remedies such as Ganmao Qingre Granules and Yinqiao Jiedu Granules) and tonic medicines, plus chemical medical products; planned expansion into tonic products and medicinal liquors.
HCPC.industry: Pharmaceutical distribution (traditional Chinese medicine and medical products) in China
HCPC.description_ja: HengHong Technology Inc.はケイマン諸島の持株会社で、Hainan HengCheng Health Industrial Co., Ltd.を中心とする中国の営業子会社を通じ、中国で医薬品を流通させる。収益は主に漢方薬・化学医薬品の流通と、2025年5月から提供を停止した関連当事者顧客向けの販促・マーケティング・サービスによる。
HCPC.products_services_ja: 漢方薬(感冒・インフルエンザ・咳止め薬の甘冒清熱顆粒、銀翹解毒顆粒など)および滋補薬の流通、化学医薬品の流通。滋補製品・薬用酒への展開を計画。

ALLN.description: Allarity Acquisition Corp. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) formed to effect a merger, share exchange, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. As a blank check company, it has no commercial operations of its own and raised capital through an initial public offering to fund a future acquisition target.
ALLN.products_services: No products or services; the company's sole purpose is to identify and complete a business combination with a privately held operating company.
ALLN.description_ja: Allarity Acquisition Corp.は、1つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換、またはそれに類する企業結合の実行を目的として設立された特別目的買収会社（SPAC）。ブランクチェック会社として独自の事業運営はなく、将来の買収対象のための資金を新規株式公開（IPO）で調達した。
ALLN.products_services_ja: 製品・サービスなし。非公開の事業会社との企業結合の特定と完了が唯一の目的。

JRWP.description: Jingrui Wang Pu Holdings Group Ltd. is a Cayman Islands holding company that, through its PRC operating entities (VIEs), sells branded electric appliances such as air-conditioners, refrigerators, televisions, and kitchen appliances via ten retail stores and 22 wholesale distributors, and also provides after-sales maintenance and repair services, business consulting, and property sublease rentals. The company is not a manufacturer but a wholesaler and retailer, with electric appliance sales accounting for about 85% of revenue for fiscal 2026.
JRWP.products_services: Retail and wholesale sales of electric appliances (air-conditioners, refrigerators, televisions, washers, dryers, dishwashers, range hoods, water kettles, food processors, rice cookers); after-sales maintenance, repair and installation services; business strategy and marketing consulting; rental of excess mall space to small businesses.
JRWP.industry: Consumer electric appliance wholesale and retail (electric appliance industry)
JRWP.description_ja: Jingrui Wang Pu Holdings Group Ltd.は、ケイマン諸島の持株会社で、中国の運営主体(VIE)を通じ、ブランド家電(エアコン、冷蔵庫、テレビ、キッチン家電等)を10の小売店と22の卸売業者経由で販売。アフターサービスの保守・修理、経営コンサルティング、モール余剰スペースの小規模事業者向け転貸も行う。製造ではなく卸売・小売業者で、2026会計年度の収益の約85%は家電販売による。
JRWP.products_services_ja: 家電の小売・卸売販売(エアコン、冷蔵庫、テレビ、洗濯機、乾燥機、食器洗い機、レンジフード、電気ケトル、フードプロセッサー、炊飯器)、アフターサービスの保守・修理・設置、経営戦略・マーケティングコンサルティング、モール余剰スペースの賃貸。

VRXA.description: Veraxa Biotech AG is a post-de-SPAC biotechnology company that became publicly listed through a business combination with a special purpose acquisition company. The firm focuses on developing therapeutic and diagnostic solutions for unmet medical needs.
VRXA.products_services: Biopharmaceutical product development, therapeutic candidates, and diagnostic solutions (specific offerings not provided; please verify against company filings).
VRXA.description_ja: Veraxa Biotech AG。SPACとの企業結合により上場したポストde-SPACのバイオテクノロジー企業。未充足の医療ニーズに応える治療・診断ソリューションの開発に注力する。
VRXA.products_services_ja: バイオ医薬品開発、治療候補品、診断ソリューション（具体的な製品は未提供。詳細は企業の開示資料で確認が必要）。

HRIA.description: Harbour Island Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company formed as a special purpose acquisition vehicle to pursue a business combination with an operating company. It is seeking to raise capital through an initial public offering and will identify and evaluate a target business for a future merger, share exchange, or similar transaction.
HRIA.products_services: No operating products or services; the company's sole activity is identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a privately held target company.
HRIA.industry: Financial Services – Blank Check Companies (Special Purpose Acquisition Companies)
HRIA.description_ja: Harbour Island Acquisition Corp. Iは、事業会社との企業結合を目的とする特別目的買収ビークルとして設立されたブランク・チェック・カンパニー。新規株式公開による資金調達を目指し、将来の合併、株式交換等の対象事業を特定・評価する。
HRIA.products_services_ja: 事業としての製品・サービスはなし。唯一の活動は、非公開の対象企業を特定・評価し、企業結合を完了すること。

GFUZ.description: General Fusion is a Canadian private fusion energy company based in Richmond, British Columbia, developing magnetized target fusion technology to produce clean, carbon-free electricity. The company is pursuing commercial fusion power plants and has been working toward a public listing through a planned merger with a special purpose acquisition company.
GFUZ.products_services: Magnetized target fusion power plant technology, fusion energy systems and components, and related research and development services for clean baseload electricity generation.
GFUZ.description_ja: General Fusion。カナダ・ブリティッシュコロンビア州リッチモンドに本拠を置く非上場の核融合エネルギー企業。磁化ターゲット核融合技術を開発し、クリーンで炭素を排出しない電力の生成を目指す。商業用核融合発電所の実現を目指し、SPACとの合併による上場を計画している。
GFUZ.products_services_ja: 磁化ターゲット核融合発電技術、核融合エネルギーシステムおよび部品、クリーンなベースロード電力生成に向けた研究開発サービス。

BOGD.description: Bogd FT Ltd is a diversified financial services group offering banking and financial services to corporate and retail customers in Mongolia, operating through its subsidiary Bogd Bank since its founding in 2014. The company provides commercial banking products including lending, deposit-taking, international remittances, insurance brokerage, foreign exchange transactions, and letter of credit issuance.
BOGD.products_services: Retail and corporate lending, deposit products, international remittances, insurance brokerage, foreign exchange transactions, banking guarantees (letters of credit), fee and commission-based products, and agricultural and rural banking products, delivered through branches, ATMs, call centers, internet and mobile channels.
BOGD.description_ja: Bogd FT Ltd は、モンゴルで法人および個人顧客向けに銀行・金融サービスを提供する多角的金融サービスグループ。2014 年設立の子会社 Bogd Bank を通じて事業を行う。融資、預金、国際送金、保険仲介、外国為替取引、信用状の発行を含む商業銀行商品を提供する。
BOGD.products_services_ja: 個人・法人向け融資、預金商品、国際送金、保険仲介、外国為替取引、銀行保証（信用状）、手数料収入型商品、農業・地方向け金融商品。支店、ATM、コールセンター、インターネットおよびモバイルチャネルを通じて提供。

0002145826.description: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an operating business. The company has no commercial operations of its own and intends to identify and combine with a privately held target company, typically in the technology sector.
0002145826.products_services: None at this time; as a blank check company, its sole activity is identifying and completing a business combination with a target company.
0002145826.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
0002145826.description_ja: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. II。新規株式公開で資金を調達し、事業会社の取得または合併を目的とするブランクチェック会社（SPAC）。自社の事業運営はなく、主にテクノロジー分野の非上場対象企業を特定し、企業結合を行う方針。
0002145826.products_services_ja: 現時点ではなし。ブランクチェック会社として、対象企業の特定と企業結合の完了のみが活動。

IPHXU.description: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VIII is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) formed to effect a merger, share exchange, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. As a blank-check vehicle, it has no commercial operations of its own and intends to pursue a target company through its public listing process.
IPHXU.products_services: None; as a blank-check company, it offers no products or services and exists to identify and complete a business combination with a privately held operating company.
IPHXU.description_ja: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VIIIは、一つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換等の企業結合を行うために設立された特別目的買収会社(SPAC)。ブランク・チェック・ビークルとして自前の事業運営はなく、上場プロセスを通じて対象企業を追求する。
IPHXU.products_services_ja: なし。ブランク・チェック・カンパニーとして製品・サービスは提供せず、非公開の事業会社との企業結合を特定・完了することが目的。

0002094989.description: RUI Holdings Inc. operates through subsidiaries that provide integrated facility management and integrated transportation/logistics services, with operations in the Middle East (including the KSA and UAE) and PRC subsidiaries referenced in the excerpt. The excerpt describes its service model and competitive risks but does not detail specific product offerings or customers.
0002094989.products_services: Integrated facility management and integrated transportation/logistics services
0002094989.industry: Integrated facility management and integrated transportation/logistics
0002094989.description_ja: RUI Holdings Inc.は、統合ファシリティマネジメントおよび統合輸送・物流サービスを提供する子会社を通じて事業を行う。中東(サウジアラビア、UAE等)での事業と、抜粋中に言及される中国の子会社がある。抜粋はサービスモデルと競争リスクを説明しているが、具体的な製品内容や顧客の詳細は記載されていない。
0002094989.products_services_ja: 統合ファシリティマネジメント、統合輸送・物流サービス

0002145409.description: GX Acquisition Corp. III is a Cayman Islands blank check company, formed as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) to pursue a business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no commercial operations of its own and raised capital through an initial public offering to fund a future merger or acquisition target.
0002145409.products_services: None; as a SPAC, the company offers no products or services and its activities are limited to identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a target company.
0002145409.description_ja: GX Acquisition Corp. III。ケイマン諸島設立のブランクチェック会社（SPAC）で、1社以上の事業会社との企業結合を目的とする。自社の事業運営はなく、新規株式公開で調達した資金を将来の合併・買収先の確保に充てる。
0002145409.products_services_ja: なし。SPACのため製品・サービスは提供せず、対象企業の選定・評価・企業結合の完了が活動の全て。

LOVIU.description: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. VI is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. As a blank-check company, it has no commercial operations of its own and seeks to bring a privately held target company public through a business combination.
LOVIU.products_services: None; as a blank-check SPAC, it offers no products or services and its activities are limited to identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a target company.
LOVIU.industry: Financial Services — Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) / Shell Company
LOVIU.description_ja: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. VI は、1 社以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換、資産取得その他の類似の企業結合を目的として設立された SPAC（特別目的買収会社）。blank check 会社として自前の営業活動はなく、非上場の対象企業を企業結合を通じて上場させることを目指す。
LOVIU.products_services_ja: なし。blank check 型 SPAC のため製品・サービスは提供せず、対象企業の探索、評価、企業結合の完了に活動を限定する。

0002097388.description: Sin Lian Seng Construction is a construction company that undertakes building and civil engineering projects. The company is positioned as a candidate for an initial public offering, pending verification of its current corporate and financial details.
0002097388.products_services: Construction services, including building construction and civil engineering works
0002097388.description_ja: Sin Lian Seng Construction。建築および土木工事を手がける建設会社。新規株式公開の候補とされるが、現時点の企業情報・財務情報は確認中。
0002097388.products_services_ja: 建設サービス（建築工事および土木工事を含む）

0002136246.description: BEHNEH Ltd is a Singapore-based financial technology company operating as a MAS-licensed money payment institution through its Singapore operating subsidiary, principally providing cross-border payment services including collection on behalf, payment on behalf, brokerage, and foreign exchange conversion. The company has also expanded into advisory, operational, and technology support services for clients establishing regulated financial services businesses.
0002136246.products_services: Cross-border payment services (collection on behalf, payment on behalf, brokerage), international fund transfers and remittance, foreign exchange conversion, and advisory/operational/technology support for regulated financial services businesses.
0002136246.industry: Financial technology (fintech) — cross-border payments and remittance
0002136246.description_ja: BEHNEH Ltd.はシンガポールを拠点とするフィンテック企業で、現地子会社を通じてMAS（シンガポール金融管理局）のマネーペイメント事業者（Money Payment Institution）ライセンスを保有する。主にクロスボーダー決済サービス（代理受取、代理支払、ブローカレッジ、外国為替換算）を提供する。近年は規制対象の金融サービス事業の立ち上げを行う顧客向けに、アドバイザリー、オペレーション、技術支援サービスにも事業を拡大している。
0002136246.products_services_ja: クロスボーダー決済サービス（代理受取、代理支払、ブローカレッジ）、国際送金、外国為替換算、規制対象金融事業向けのアドバイザリー・オペレーション・技術支援。

CSEA.description: Calm Seas Acquisition Corp. is a newly formed blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), organized to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an operating business. The company has no commercial operations of its own and intends to identify and complete a business combination with a target company, typically within a defined period following its IPO.
CSEA.products_services: As a blank check company, Calm Seas Acquisition Corp. does not offer products or services; its sole activity is raising capital and pursuing a business combination with a privately held operating company.
CSEA.industry: Financial Services – Shell Companies / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
CSEA.description_ja: Calm Seas Acquisition Corp. は新設の blank check 会社（SPAC）で、新規株式公開を通じて資金を調達し、事業会社の買収または合併を目的として組成された。自前の営業活動はなく、IPO 後の一定期間内に対象企業との企業結合を特定・完了することを意図している。
CSEA.products_services_ja: blank check 会社のため製品・サービスは提供しない。活動は、資金調達と非上場の事業会社との企業結合の追求に限られる。

IQMX.description: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj is a Finnish company that designs and manufactures superconducting quantum computers for research institutions, governments, and enterprises. The company is pursuing an initial public offering as it scales its quantum hardware business in Europe and globally.
IQMX.products_services: Superconducting quantum computers, quantum processors, quantum control systems, and related software and cloud access for quantum computing workloads.
IQMX.description_ja: IQM Quantum Computers Oyjは、研究機関、政府、企業向けに超伝導量子コンピュータを設計・製造するフィンランド企業。欧州および世界で量子ハードウェア事業を拡大する中、新規株式公開を目指している。
IQMX.products_services_ja: 超伝導量子コンピュータ、量子プロセッサ、量子制御システム、および量子コンピューティングのワークロード向けの関連ソフトウェアとクラウドアクセス。

BMB.description: Bamboo Insurance Services, Inc. is a company operating in the insurance services sector, offering insurance-related solutions to consumers and businesses. Its public offering positions it to raise capital for growth, technology investment, and expansion of its insurance distribution and service capabilities.
BMB.products_services: Insurance services and related solutions, which may include policy administration, distribution, and customer-facing insurance products (specific offerings not verified).
BMB.description_ja: Bamboo Insurance Services, Inc.。消費者・法人向けに保険関連ソリューションを提供する保険サービス分野の企業。公募により成長資金、技術投資、保険の販売・サービス能力の拡大に向けた資本を調達する。
BMB.products_services_ja: 保険サービスおよび関連ソリューション（保険契約管理、販売、顧客向け保険商品などを含む可能性があるが、具体的な内容は未確認）。

0002143156.description: Lucens Capital Acquisition Corp I is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no commercial operations of its own and raises capital through an initial public offering to identify and acquire a target company.
0002143156.products_services: None; as a SPAC, the company does not offer products or services and instead seeks to complete a business combination with a privately held operating company.
0002143156.industry: Financial Services - Shell Companies / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
0002143156.description_ja: Lucens Capital Acquisition Corp I は、1 社以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換その他の類似の企業結合を目的とする blank check 会社（SPAC）である。自前の営業活動はなく、新規株式公開で資金を調達し、買収対象企業を探索・取得する。
0002143156.products_services_ja: なし。SPAC のため製品・サービスは提供せず、非上場の事業会社との企業結合の完了を目指す。

BHAIU.description: BHAV Acquisition Corp II is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. The company has no operations of its own and intends to use the proceeds of its initial public offering to identify and complete a target acquisition.
BHAIU.products_services: As a blank check company, BHAV Acquisition Corp II does not offer products or services; its activity consists of identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a privately held operating company.
BHAIU.industry: Financial Services - Shell Companies / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
BHAIU.description_ja: BHAV Acquisition Corp II。合併、株式交換、資産取得などの企業結合を1社以上の事業会社と行うために設立されたブランクチェック会社（SPAC）。自社の事業運営はなく、新規株式公開の調達資金で買収対象を特定し取引を完了する方針。
BHAIU.products_services_ja: ブランクチェック会社として製品・サービスは提供しない。非上場の事業会社との企業結合の検討・完了が活動の全て。

0002084038.description: Yi Feng Holdings Ltd. is a Hong Kong construction subcontractor providing civil engineering services (permanent electrical engineering works, temporary electrical and plumbing systems, vertical material handling) and steel cutting services for removing temporary steel structures at construction sites, and it also sells recyclable steel collected from those projects. Its customers are mainly main contractors and subcontractors on private and public building and infrastructure projects in Hong Kong, including residential, commercial, public housing, government, school, hospital and transport projects.
0002084038.products_services: Civil engineering subcontracting services (permanent electrical engineering works, temporary electrical and plumbing systems, vertical material handling) and steel cutting services for removal of temporary steel structures; sales of recyclable steel.
0002084038.industry: Construction (Hong Kong construction subcontracting, civil/electrical engineering and steel cutting)
0002084038.description_ja: Yi Feng Holdings Ltd. は香港の建設業者向け下請け会社で、恒久的な電気工事、仮設の電気・配管システム、垂直搬送などの土木工事サービスと、建設現場の仮設鉄骨撤去のための鉄骨切断サービスを提供する。あわせて、現場で回収したリサイクル可能な鉄鋼を販売している。顧客は主に香港の民間・公共の建築・インフラ工事の元請けおよび下請け業者で、住宅、商業施設、公営住宅、政府、学校、病院、交通関連などのプロジェクトを含む。
0002084038.products_services_ja: 土木工事の下請けサービス（恒久的電気工事、仮設の電気・配管システム、垂直搬送）、仮設鉄骨撤去のための鉄骨切断サービス、リサイクル鉄鋼の販売。

HYACU.description: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no operations of its own and raises capital through an initial public offering to identify and acquire a target company, typically in the consumer, branded, and related sectors.
HYACU.products_services: None; as a blank check company, it offers no products or services and exists solely to complete a business combination with a privately held operating company.
HYACU.industry: Financial Services - Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs) / Shell Companies
HYACU.description_ja: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V。合併、株式交換、資産取得などの企業結合を1社以上の事業会社と行うために設立されたブランクチェック会社（SPAC）。自社の事業運営はなく、新規株式公開で調達した資金により、主に消費財・ブランド関連分野の買収対象を特定・取得する。
HYACU.products_services_ja: なし。ブランクチェック会社として製品・サービスは提供せず、非上場事業会社との企業結合の完了のみを目的とする。

0002097903.description: UDynamics Ltd is a BVI holding company that conducts its operations through its Hong Kong subsidiary UDomain, a technology solutions provider with a technical heritage dating to 1998. It offers cloud hosting and management, IT solution services (including cybersecurity, applications development, and blockchain solutions), and domain registration services to over 20,000 companies across Hong Kong, China, and Asia.
0002097903.products_services: Cloud hosting and management services (shared web hosting, dedicated cloud, multi-cloud architecture, managed cloud); cybersecurity services (managed security, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, advanced threat detection); applications development (website, mobile, enterprise, and blockchain applications); domain registration services.
0002097903.industry: Information technology services (cloud hosting, cybersecurity, and digital solutions)
0002097903.description_ja: UDynamics Ltd は英領バージン諸島の持株会社で、香港子会社 UDomain を通じて事業を行う。UDomain は 1998 年にさかのぼる技術的な歴史を持つテクノロジーソリューションプロバイダー。香港、中国およびアジアの 2 万社超にクラウドホスティング・管理、IT ソリューションサービス（サイバーセキュリティ、アプリケーション開発、ブロックチェーンソリューションを含む）、ドメイン登録サービスを提供する。
0002097903.products_services_ja: クラウドホスティング・管理サービス（共有型ウェブホスティング、専用クラウド、マルチクラウド構成、マネージドクラウド）、サイバーセキュリティサービス（マネージドセキュリティ、ペネトレーションテスト、脆弱性診断、高度な脅威検知）、アプリケーション開発（ウェブ、モバイル、エンタープライズ、ブロックチェーンアプリケーション）、ドメイン登録サービス。

0002110025.description: Siyata PTT is a Cayman Islands-incorporated developer of cellular-based push-to-talk communications solutions over 4G/LTE and 5G networks, serving first responders and enterprise customers under the Siyata brands. Its products include rugged handheld mobile devices and in-vehicle communications solutions for first responders, military, enterprise, commercial fleet, and industrial customers.
0002110025.products_services: Rugged handheld cellular mobile devices and in-vehicle communications solutions for first responders, military, enterprise customers, commercial fleet vehicles and industrial workers.
0002110025.industry: Telecommunications equipment / mobile communications (cellular push-to-talk communications for public safety and enterprise)
0002110025.description_ja: Siyata PTTは、ケイマン諸島法人として設立され、4G/LTEおよび5Gネットワーク上で動作するセルラー方式のプッシュ・トゥ・トーク通信ソリューションを開発する。Siyataブランドの下、第一対応者とエンタープライズ顧客に提供する。製品は第一対応者、軍、企業、商用車両群、産業顧客向けの耐久型携帯端末と車載通信ソリューション。
0002110025.products_services_ja: 第一対応者、軍、企業顧客、商用車両群、産業従事者向けの耐久型携帯セルラー端末および車載通信ソリューション。

0002138170.description: Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no commercial operations of its own and seeks a target company to take public through a business combination, with its shareholders and sponsors receiving the benefits of the eventual target's growth.
0002138170.products_services: None; the company has no products or services. Its activity consists of identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a private operating company.
0002138170.industry: Financial Services - Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (Blank Check Shell Companies)
0002138170.description_ja: Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. V。合併、株式交換、資産取得などの企業結合を1社以上の事業会社と行うために設立されたブランクチェック会社（SPAC）。自社の事業運営はなく、企業結合を通じて対象企業を上場させる先を探す。株主とスポンサーは対象企業の成長の恩恵を受ける。
0002138170.products_services_ja: なし。製品・サービスは提供せず、非上場事業会社との企業結合の検討・完了が活動の全て。

TBCVU.description: Thunder Bridge Capital Partners V, Ltd. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), a blank-check vehicle formed to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an operating business. Its details, including its IPO status, trust account, and target sector, are not confirmed in my records, so verify them against its SEC filings.
TBCVU.products_services: As a blank-check company, it has no operating products or services; its activity consists of identifying and completing a business combination with a private target company.
TBCVU.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
TBCVU.description_ja: Thunder Bridge Capital Partners V, Ltd.は、新規株式公開により資金を調達し、事業会社の買収または合併を目的として設立された特別目的買収会社(SPAC)、すなわちブランク・チェック・カンパニー。新規株式公開の状況、信託口座、対象分野などの詳細は当方の記録では確認できないため、SEC提出書類で確認が必要。
TBCVU.products_services_ja: ブランク・チェック・カンパニーのため事業としての製品・サービスはなし。非公開の対象企業を特定し、企業結合を完了することが活動の中心。

0002160422.description: Kartoon Studios Acquisition Corp. is a special purpose acquisition company formed to pursue a business combination with an operating company in the media and entertainment sector. The vehicle raises capital through an initial public offering with the goal of acquiring or merging with a target business that can benefit from public market access.
0002160422.products_services: As a blank check company, Kartoon Studios Acquisition Corp. does not offer products or services of its own; its purpose is to identify and complete a business combination with a privately held target company.
0002160422.industry: Financial Services – Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), with a focus on media and entertainment targets
0002160422.description_ja: Kartoon Studios Acquisition Corp.は、メディア・エンターテインメント分野の事業会社との企業結合を目的として設立された特別目的買収会社。新規株式公開（IPO）で資金を調達し、公開市場へのアクセスから恩恵を受ける対象事業の買収または合併を目指す。
0002160422.products_services_ja: ブランクチェック（白紙会社）であるため、自社の製品・サービスは持たない。非公開の対象企業との企業結合を特定し、完了させることが目的。

OHII.description: Oceanhawk Acquisition II Corp. is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an operating business. As a SPAC, it has no commercial operations of its own and is expected to identify a target company, typically within a set timeframe, to complete a business combination.
OHII.products_services: None currently; the company's sole purpose is to effect a business combination with a privately held operating company, which would then determine its products and services.
OHII.industry: Financial Services – Special Purpose Acquisition Company (Blank Check)
OHII.description_ja: Oceanhawk Acquisition II Corp.は、ブランク・チェック・カンパニー(特別目的買収会社、SPAC)で、新規株式公開により資金を調達し、事業会社の買収または合併を目的として設立された。SPACとして自前の事業運営はなく、通常は定められた期間内に対象企業を選定し、企業結合を完了することが想定される。
OHII.products_services_ja: 現時点で該当なし。非公開の事業会社との企業結合が唯一の目的であり、製品・サービスは結合後の事業会社が決定する。

RZRA.description: Rezera Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing proprietary, oral NLRP3 inhibitors to reduce sterile inflammation and residual inflammatory risk in cardiovascular and neurologic diseases. Its lead candidate, ruvonoflast, is being developed first for peripheral artery disease and later for broader atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
RZRA.products_services: Ruvonoflast, an oral NLRP3 inhibitor (lead product candidate, in clinical development); portfolio of other oral NLRP3 inhibitors
RZRA.description_ja: Rezera Inc.は、心血管疾患および神経疾患における無菌性炎症と残存炎症リスクの低減を目指し、独自の経口NLRP3阻害剤を開発する臨床段階のバイオテクノロジー企業。主要候補のruvonoflastは、まず末梢動脈疾患を対象に開発され、その後より広範な動脈硬化性心血管疾患への適応が予定されている。
RZRA.products_services_ja: ruvonoflast（経口NLRP3阻害剤、主要開発候補、臨床開発中）、その他の経口NLRP3阻害剤のポートフォリオ。

RNAQU.description: Rainier Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an operating business. Its management team intends to identify and complete a business combination with a target company, typically within a defined timeframe.
RNAQU.products_services: No operating products or services; the company's sole activity is identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a privately held target company.
RNAQU.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
RNAQU.description_ja: Rainier Acquisition Corp.は、新規株式公開（IPO）で資金を調達し、事業会社の買収または合併を目的として設立されたブランクチェック会社（特別目的買収会社、SPAC）。経営陣は、定められた期間内に対象企業との企業結合を特定し、完了させることを目指す。
RNAQU.products_services_ja: 独自の事業製品・サービスはなし。唯一の活動は非公開の対象企業の特定、評価、企業結合の完了。

JTTT.description: JATT III Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no commercial operations of its own and is structured to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of identifying and completing an acquisition target.
JTTT.products_services: No products or services; the company's sole activity is identifying and consummating a business combination with a target company.
JTTT.industry: Financial Services - Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) / Shell Company
JTTT.description_ja: JATT III Acquisition Corp.は、1つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換、資産取得、またはそれに類する企業結合の実行を目的として設立されたブランクチェック会社（特別目的買収会社、SPAC）。独自の事業運営はなく、買収対象の特定と取引完了のため、新規株式公開（IPO）で資金を調達する構造となっている。
JTTT.products_services_ja: 製品・サービスなし。唯一の活動は対象企業との企業結合の特定と完了。

SCATU.description: Southern Cross Acquisition II Corp. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), a blank-check vehicle formed to raise capital through an initial public offering for the purpose of acquiring or merging with an existing private company. It has no commercial operations of its own, and its management team seeks a suitable target business to take public through a business combination.
SCATU.products_services: None; as a blank-check SPAC, the company offers no products or services and its sole activity is identifying and completing a business combination with a target company.
SCATU.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
SCATU.description_ja: Southern Cross Acquisition II Corp.は、新規株式公開（IPO）で資金を調達し、既存の非公開企業の買収または合併を目的とする特別目的買収会社（SPAC）、いわゆるブランクチェック会社。独自の事業運営はなく、経営陣は企業結合を通じて株式公開させる適切な対象企業を探している。
SCATU.products_services_ja: なし。ブランクチェックSPACとして製品・サービスは提供せず、唯一の活動は対象企業との企業結合の特定と完了。

FBDT.description: First Breach, Inc. is a Delaware corporation that manufactures match-grade ammunition components, including brass cups and casings, full-metal-jacket projectiles, lead projectile cores, and lead wire, built to SAAMI specifications. The company is also in the development stage on unmanned aerial systems through a joint venture (First Forge Technologies Inc.) and a master services agreement, but has not yet generated revenue from that business.
FBDT.products_services: Match-grade ammunition components: brass cups, brass casings (including custom head-stamped casings), full-metal-jacket projectiles, lead projectile cores, and lead wire; in development: drone platforms for defense, homeland security, and commercial applications.
FBDT.industry: Ammunition manufacturing (firearms/ammunition components), with an emerging presence in defense unmanned aerial systems.
FBDT.description_ja: First Breach, Inc.はデラウェア州法人で、SAAMI規格に準拠したマッチグレード弾薬部品を製造する。真鍮カップおよび薬莢、フルメタルジャケット弾頭、鉛弾芯、鉛ワイヤーなどを扱う。合弁会社First Forge Technologies Inc.およびマスター・サービス契約を通じ、無人航空システムの開発段階にあるが、当該事業からの収益はまだ生じていない。
FBDT.products_services_ja: マッチグレード弾薬部品：真鍮カップ、真鍮薬莢（カスタム刻印薬莢を含む）、フルメタルジャケット弾頭、鉛弾芯、鉛ワイヤー。開発中：防衛、国土安全保障、商業用途向けのドローンプラットフォーム。

LYNX.description: Lyntris Inc. is a defense technology company that delivers "sense-to-act" connectivity solutions for the connected battlespace, serving U.S. Department of War and allied nation military customers across Maritime Domain Awareness, Air & Missile Defense, and Space ISR & Resilient Communications missions. Its offerings span sensor architecture, proprietary sensor and antenna hardware, and data and software platforms for fusion, command-and-control, and mission execution.
LYNX.products_services: Sensor architecture engineering, proprietary sensor and antenna subsystems (RF, radar, power and thermal management), and data and software platforms for ingesting, fusing, visualizing data and supporting command-and-control.
LYNX.industry: Defense technology (military sensing, communications, and connectivity systems)
LYNX.description_ja: Lyntris Inc.は、コネクテッド・バトルスペース向けの「センス・トゥ・アクト（感知から行動へ）」接続ソリューションを提供する防衛テクノロジー企業。米国防総省（Department of War）および同盟国の軍を顧客とし、海洋領域認識、防空・ミサイル防衛、宇宙ISR・耐障害通信の各ミッションを手がける。センサーアーキテクチャ、独自のセンサー・アンテナハードウェア、データ融合・指揮統制・任務遂行のためのデータ・ソフトウェアプラットフォームを展開する。
LYNX.products_services_ja: センサーアーキテクチャ設計、独自のセンサー・アンテナサブシステム（RF、レーダー、電源・熱管理）、データの取り込み・融合・可視化および指揮統制を支援するデータ・ソフトウェアプラットフォーム。

NSAIU.description: NorthStrive Acquisition Corp I is a blank-check special purpose acquisition company formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no operations of its own and seeks to take a target company public through its initial public offering and subsequent business combination.
NSAIU.products_services: No operating products or services; the company's sole purpose is to identify and complete a business combination with a privately held target company.
NSAIU.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs)
NSAIU.description_ja: NorthStrive Acquisition Corp Iは、1つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換、資産取得、またはそれに類する企業結合の実行を目的として設立されたブランクチェック型の特別目的買収会社（SPAC）。独自の事業運営はなく、新規株式公開（IPO）とその後の企業結合を通じて対象企業を株式公開させることを目指す。
NSAIU.products_services_ja: 独自の事業製品・サービスはなし。唯一の目的は非公開の対象企業との企業結合の特定と完了。

FOIL.description: Londian Wason New Energy Tech Inc. is a global innovation-driven researcher, developer, and manufacturer of electrolytic copper foil, and according to the excerpt it was the world's largest supplier of lithium-ion battery copper foil by sales volume in 2025. Its products, primarily LiB copper foil and PCB-grade copper foil (plus some FCCLs), serve customers in electric vehicles, energy storage systems, communication equipment, and consumer electronics.
FOIL.products_services: Electrolytic copper foil, including LiB copper foil (used as a current collector in lithium-ion battery cells), PCB-grade copper foil (used in printed circuit boards and electronic circuits), and to a lesser extent FCCLs.
FOIL.industry: Advanced materials / copper foil manufacturing for lithium-ion batteries and electronic circuit boards (serving EV, energy storage, and electronics markets).
FOIL.description_ja: Londian Wason New Energy Tech Inc.は、電解銅箔のグローバルなイノベーション主導型の研究開発・製造企業。抜粋によれば、2025年の販売数量でリチウムイオン電池用銅箔の世界最大のサプライヤーであった。主製品はLiB用銅箔およびPCB用銅箔（一部FCCL）で、電気自動車、蓄電システム、通信機器、家電製品などの顧客に供給している。
FOIL.products_services_ja: 電解銅箔：LiB用銅箔（リチウムイオン電池セルの集電体として使用）、PCB用銅箔（プリント基板および電子回路に使用）、およびそれより少量のFCCL。

LTGO.description: Latigo Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company focused on developing novel therapeutics. Details on its pipeline, clinical programs, and IPO terms should be verified against its SEC filings and offering materials.

The company is preparing for an initial public offering to fund growth in its nuclear infrastructure and clean energy initiatives.
HNUC.products_services: Spent fuel storage and transportation systems (dry cask storage), nuclear plant decommissioning services, SMR (small modular reactor) development, nuclear components and engineering services
HNUC.description_ja: Holtec Nuclear Corp.は、米国を拠点とする原子力技術企業であり、使用済み核燃料の貯蔵システム、廃炉サービス、先進炉の開発を、世界中の電力会社や政府機関の顧客向けに提供している。原子力インフラとクリーンエネルギー事業の成長資金を調達するため、新規株式公開に向けて準備を進めている。
HNUC.products_services_ja: 使用済み燃料の貯蔵・輸送システム（乾式キャスク貯蔵）、原子力発電所の廃炉サービス、SMR（小型モジュール炉）の開発、原子力部品およびエンジニアリングサービス。

HYAC.description: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It raises capital through an initial public offering with the aim of identifying and acquiring a privately held target company, and it has no commercial operations of its own prior to such a transaction.
HYAC.products_services: None; as a SPAC, Haymaker Acquisition Corp V does not offer products or services and exists to pursue an acquisition of an operating business.
HYAC.industry: Financial Services / Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (Blank Check Companies)
HYAC.description_ja: Haymaker Acquisition Corp Vは blank check company（白紙会社）、いわゆるSPAC（特別目的買収会社）。1つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換、または同様の企業結合を目的として設立。IPOで資金を調達し、非公開の買収対象企業を特定・買収することを目指す。当該取引以前に自社の商業活動はない。
HYAC.products_services_ja: なし。SPACとして製品・サービスは提供せず、事業会社の買収の実現を目的として存在する。

0002111838.description: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V is a blank check company, also known as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. It has no commercial operations of its own and is seeking to complete an initial public offering to raise capital for a future acquisition target.
0002111838.products_services: None; as a blank check company, it offers no products or services and exists solely to identify and complete a business combination with a private operating company.
0002111838.industry: Financial Services (Special Purpose Acquisition Companies / Blank Check Companies)
0002111838.description_ja: Haymaker Acquisition Corp Vは blank check company（白紙会社）、いわゆるSPAC（特別目的買収会社）。1つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換、資産取得または同様の企業結合を目的として設立。自社の商業活動はなく、将来の買収対象のための資金調達を目的にIPOを完了することを目指す。
0002111838.products_services_ja: なし。白紙会社として製品・サービスは提供せず、非公開の事業会社との企業結合の実現のみを目的として存在する。

TBCV.description: Thunder Bridge Capital Partners V, Ltd. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) formed to effect a merger, share exchange, or similar business combination with one or more operating businesses. Its public filings and offering materials describe a blank-check vehicle that seeks targets primarily in the financial technology and financial services sectors.
TBCV.products_services: The company does not currently offer products or services; as a blank-check company, its activity consists of identifying, evaluating, and completing a business combination with a target company.
TBCV.industry: Financial Services (Special Purpose Acquisition Company / Blank Check)
TBCV.description_ja: Thunder Bridge Capital Partners V, Ltd.は1つ以上の事業会社との合併、株式交換または同様の企業結合を目的として設立されたSPAC（特別目的買収会社）。公開資料によれば、主にフィンテックおよび金融サービス分野の対象企業を探す白紙型の投資ビークルと位置付けられている。
TBCV.products_services_ja: 現時点で製品・サービスは提供していない。白紙会社として、対象企業の特定・評価と企業結合の完了が主な活動となる。

NSTR.description: NorthStar Earth & Space Enterprises, Inc. is a data analytics company building dedicated infrastructure for space-based Space Situational and Domain Awareness, using optical sensors on third-party host satellites fused with ground-based radar, optical, and RF data to detect, track, and analyze resident space objects in real time. It serves defense, civil-space, and commercial operators with early detection of deliberate space threats and space traffic management analytics.
NSTR.products_services: Real-time resident space object (RSO) detection, tracking, and analytics, including orbital dynamics and machine learning algorithms for space situational and domain awareness and space traffic management.
NSTR.industry: Space data analytics / space situational awareness (aerospace and defense technology)
NSTR.description_ja: NorthStar Earth & Space Enterprises, Inc.。宇宙空間状況認識（SSA）および宇宙領域認識（SDA）のため、第三者の母衛星に搭載した光学センサーと、地上のレーダー・光学・RFデータを統合する専用インフラを構築するデータ分析企業。軌道上物体をリアルタイムで検知・追跡・分析し、防衛、民生宇宙、商業事業者にサービスを提供する。意図的な宇宙脅威の早期検知や宇宙交通管理の分析も提供する。
NSTR.products_services_ja: 宇宙物体（RSO）のリアルタイム検知・追跡・分析。軌道力学および機械学習アルゴリズムを用いた、宇宙状況認識・領域認識と宇宙交通管理の分析。

0002087307.description: Sensing4D AI Ltd, founded in June 2020, specializes in the research, development, and application of AI-driven 3D vision technology, offering high-precision 3D reconstruction, robotics 3D vision, embodied intelligence simulation training grounds, and industry-specific applications through its proprietary Sen-3D Platform. The company serves enterprise clients in sectors such as industrial parks, robotics, digital cities, forestry technology, and smart manufacturing with technology products and professional services.
0002087307.products_services: Sen-3D Platform (comprising Sen-Modeling perception modeling engine and Sen-Creation simulation engine), 3D reconstruction, robotics 3D vision, embodied intelligence simulation training grounds, 4D structured embodied data acquisition system, SenMirror App for mobile 3D modeling and AR interaction, and personalized digital content creation.
0002087307.description_ja: Sensing4D AI Ltd.は2020年6月設立。AIによる3Dビジョン技術の研究開発および応用を専門とし、高精度3D再構築、ロボティクス向け3Dビジョン、エンボディドAIのシミュレーション訓練場、独自のSen-3D Platformを通じた業界別ソリューションを提供する。産業団地、ロボティクス、デジタルシティ、林業テクノロジー、スマート製造などの分野の法人顧客に、技術製品と専門サービスを提供する。
0002087307.products_services_ja: Sen-3D Platform（知覚モデリングエンジンSen-Modelingとシミュレーションエンジン Sen-Creationで構成）、3D再構築、ロボティクス向け3Dビジョン、エンボディドAIシミュレーション訓練場、4D構造化エンボディドデータ取得システム、モバイル3Dモデリング・AR対話用のSenMirror App、パーソナライズされたデジタルコンテンツ制作。

0002088286.description: Danneskjold & Galt Acquisition Co is a Cayman Islands blank check company incorporated in September 2025 to effect a business combination with one or more operating businesses. It intends to focus its search on targets in the financial technology and artificial intelligence sectors.
0002088286.industry: Blank check / special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) with a stated focus on financial technology and artificial intelligence
0002088286.description_ja: Danneskjold & Galt Acquisition Co。2025年9月に設立されたケイマン諸島のブランクチェック会社で、1社以上の事業会社との企業結合を目的とする。対象はフィンテックおよび人工知能分野を中心に探索する予定。

0002098038.description: Zensitive Holding Ltd is a Cayman Islands holding company that, through its Hong Kong operating subsidiary Zensitive Limited, provides end-to-end project management services for fit-out works covering HVAC, fire protection, electrical, plumbing, painting, partitioning, finishes, fittings, and furniture installation for commercial and residential properties. In fiscal 2025 it reported revenue of approximately HK$59.6 million, up from HK$12.0 million in fiscal 2024.
0002098038.products_services: End-to-end project management services for interior fit-out works (HVAC, fire protection, electrical, plumbing, painting, partition walls, wall and floor finishes, decorative fittings, furniture and fixtures) for commercial and residential projects in Hong Kong.
0002098038.industry: Construction and interior fit-out services (building project management)
0002098038.description_ja: Zensitive Holding Ltd。ケイマン諸島の持株会社で、香港の運営子会社Zensitive Limitedを通じ、商業用・住宅用物件の内装工事（空調、消防、電気、配管、塗装、間仕切り、仕上げ、設備、家具設置）のエンドツーエンドのプロジェクト管理サービスを提供する。2025年度の売上高は約5,960万香港ドルで、2024年度の1,200万香港ドルから増加。
0002098038.products_services_ja: 香港における商業・住宅プロジェクト向け内装工事のエンドツーエンド・プロジェクト管理（空調、消防、電気、配管、塗装、間仕切り壁、壁・床仕上げ、装飾設備、家具・造作）。

0001907709.description: vVARDIS Holding AG is a healthcare company whose proprietary peptide-enabled Curodont® platform is positioned as a clinically validated, drill-free treatment for early-stage cavities that aims to stop decay progression and repair enamel. Its flagship products, Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus (sold in the U.S. as an OTC drug) and Curodont® Repair (sold in other markets), generated $30.2 million in net revenue for 2025.
0001907709.products_services: Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus and Curodont® Repair, peptide-containing dental formulations for treating early-stage cavities (tooth decay).
0001907709.industry: Dental healthcare / dental products (oral care and restorative dentistry).
0001907709.description_ja: vVARDIS Holding AG はヘルスケア企業で、独自のペプチド技術を用いた Curodont® プラットフォームを展開する。初期段階のう蝕（虫歯）に対し、ドリルを使わずに、う蝕の進行を止め、エナメル質を修復することを狙う治療法として位置づけられ、臨床的な検証を謳う。主力製品の Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus（米国では OTC 医薬品として販売）と Curodont® Repair（その他の市場で販売）により、2025 年の純売上高は 3,020 万ドルだった。
0001907709.products_services_ja: Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus および Curodont® Repair。初期段階のう蝕（虫歯）の治療に用いるペプチド配合の歯科用製剤。

0000715837.description: LPC Ltd operates through its Malaysian subsidiary Lotus Power Corporation (M) Sdn. Bhd., which supplies electrical distribution equipment and provides integrated supply, testing and commissioning services across Malaysia. The company resells third-party manufactured transformers, switchgear and related equipment to sectors including buildings and infrastructure, utilities, railways, renewable energy, mining, marine and data centres.
0000715837.products_services: Medium voltage switchgears, medium voltage transformers, extra high voltage switchgears, power transformers, and low voltage distribution feeder pillars, plus project coordination, procurement, factory acceptance testing, delivery, and coordinated installation, testing and commissioning support.
0000715837.industry: Electrical equipment supply and distribution (electrical distribution equipment trading and project services)
0000715837.description_ja: LPC Ltd.は、マレーシア子会社Lotus Power Corporation (M) Sdn. Bhd.を通じ、マレーシア国内に配電機器を供給し、統合的な供給・試験・試運転サービスを提供する。第三者製造の変圧器、開閉装置等の関連機器を再販し、建築・インフラ、電力会社、鉄道、再生可能エネルギー、鉱業、海洋、データセンター等の分野に販売。
0000715837.products_services_ja: 中電圧開閉装置、中電圧変圧器、超高圧開閉装置、電力用変圧器、低電圧配電フィーダーピラー。プロジェクト調整、調達、工場受入試験、納入、据付・試験・試運転の支援。

0002144445.description: UC Automotive Holdings Inc. operates a used vehicle dealership and automotive services business in Canada, headquartered in Richmond, British Columbia and focused on the Greater Vancouver area. The company combines used vehicle sales, vehicle leasing and rental, rent-to-own programs, financing support and after-sales services.
0002144445.products_services: Used vehicle sales, vehicle leasing and rental, rent-to-own programs, financing support, and after-sales services.
0002144445.industry: Used vehicle dealership and automotive services (automotive retail).
0002144445.description_ja: UC Automotive Holdings Inc. はカナダで中古車販売店および自動車関連サービス事業を営む。本社はブリティッシュコロンビア州リッチモンドにあり、グレーター・バンクーバー地域を主な営業エリアとする。中古車販売、車両リースおよびレンタル、レントトゥオウン（所有型レンタル）プログラム、金融支援、アフターサービスを組み合わせて提供する。
0002144445.products_services_ja: 中古車販売、車両のリースおよびレンタル、レントトゥオウン・プログラム、金融支援、アフターサービス。

HCAX.description: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp II is a newly incorporated Cayman Islands blank check company formed to effect a business combination with one or more businesses, and it has not yet selected any target. It intends to focus on high-growth companies in critical materials, infrastructure, and defense-aligned technology sectors.
HCAX.industry: Blank check company / special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) seeking acquisitions in critical materials, infrastructure, and defense-aligned technology
HCAX.description_ja: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp II は、1 社以上の事業との企業結合を目的として新たに設立されたケイマン諸島の blank check 会社であり、まだ買収対象を選定していない。重要鉱物、インフラ、防衛関連技術の分野で成長性の高い企業を重点対象とする方針。

WATR.description: Air Water Ventures Ltd is a sustainable water solutions company that makes premium drinking water by extracting humidity from the air, selling it in aluminum cans, bottles, and glass bottles. It also manufactures atmospheric water generators (AWGs) ranging from counter-top consumer units to 3,000 liter/day industrial systems, and builds and operates water farms and bottling sites.
WATR.products_services: Premium packaged drinking water (aluminum cans, glass and plastic-free bottles); atmospheric water generators (AWGs) from consumer counter-top units to 3,000 liter/day industrial systems; construction and operation of water farms and bottling sites.
WATR.industry: Sustainable water solutions / bottled water and atmospheric water generation technology
WATR.description_ja: Air Water Ventures Ltdは、空気中の湿気を抽出してプレミアム飲料水を製造する持続可能な水ソリューション企業。アルミ缶、ボトル、ガラス瓶で販売するほか、卓上型の家庭用から1日3,000リットルの産業用までの大気水生成機(AWG)を製造し、ウォーターファーム及びボトリング施設の建設・運営も行う。
WATR.products_services_ja: プレミアム容器入り飲料水(アルミ缶、ガラス瓶、プラスチックフリーボトル)、大気水生成機(AWG、家庭用卓上型から1日3,000リットルの産業用まで)、ウォーターファーム及びボトリング施設の建設・運営。

ADBT.description: Advasa Holdings, Inc. is a Delaware holding company for Advasa Co., Ltd. (Tokyo, Japan), a financial technology company focused on improving how employees access and manage their earned income. Its core FUKUPE platform is a patented Earned Wage Access solution that lets employees access earned wages in real time, delivered as a hosted cloud service integrated with employers' HR and payroll systems.
ADBT.products_services: FUKUPE, a patented Earned Wage Access (EWA) platform delivered as a hosted, cloud-based service, accessible via mobile wallets, prepaid cards, and direct bank transfers, with the employer bearing no operational burden or funding obligation.
ADBT.industry: Financial technology (fintech) / Earned Wage Access and financial services
ADBT.description_ja: Advasa Holdings, Inc.は、Advasa Co., Ltd.（東京都）の持株会社（デラウェア州法人）。Advasa Co., Ltd.は、従業員が獲得済みの給与へアクセスし管理する方法の改善に注力するフィンテック企業。主力のFUKUPEプラットフォームは特許取得済みの給与前払い（Earned Wage Access）ソリューションで、従業員がリアルタイムで給与を引き出せるよう、雇用主の人事・給与システムと連携するホスト型クラウドサービスとして提供される。
ADBT.products_services_ja: FUKUPE：特許取得済みの給与前払い（EWA）プラットフォーム。ホスト型クラウドサービスとして提供され、モバイルウォレット、プリペイドカード、銀行直接振込で利用可能。雇用主に運用負担や資金拠出の義務はない。

VOGX.description: Vogenx, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies for serious metabolic diseases, with its lead candidate mizagliflozin (a selective SGLT1 inhibitor) in development for post-bariatric hypoglycemia, gastroparesis, and GIP-dependent Cushing's Syndrome. The company does not currently sell any products; it is advancing investigational drug candidates through clinical trials toward regulatory approval.
VOGX.products_services: Investigational drug candidates, lead candidate mizagliflozin (oral SGLT1 inhibitor) and preclinical candidate VGX-2857; no commercial products or services are currently sold.
VOGX.description_ja: Vogenx, Inc.は、重篤な代謝性疾患向けの新規治療法を開発する臨床段階のバイオ医薬品企業。主力候補はmizagliflozin（選択的SGLT1阻害薬）で、減量手術後低血糖、胃不全麻痺、GIP依存性クッシング症候群を適応症として開発中。現時点で販売中の製品はなく、治験を通じて承認取得を目指す段階。
VOGX.products_services_ja: 開発中の候補薬：主力候補mizagliflozin（経口SGLT1阻害薬）、前臨床候補VGX-2857。現在販売中の製品・サービスはなし。

BLSM.description: BlossomHill Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing small molecule cancer medicines designed using structure-based rational drug design. Its lead programs include BH-30643, an investigational EGFR inhibitor for EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, and BH-30236, a CLK inhibitor for relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia and higher-risk myelodysplastic syndromes, plus a preclinical KRAS-targeting candidate.
BLSM.products_services: Investigational small molecule drug candidates: BH-30643 (EGFR inhibitor, clinical-stage), BH-30236 (CLK inhibitor, clinical-stage), and BH-501284 (KRAS-targeting, preclinical).
BLSM.description_ja: BlossomHill Therapeutics は、構造ベースの合理的創薬によって設計された低分子抗がん剤を開発する臨床段階のバイオ医薬品企業。主要プログラムは、EGFR変異陽性非小細胞肺がん向けの開発中EGFR阻害薬BH-30643、再発・難治性急性骨髄性白血病および高リスク骨髄異形成症候群向けのCLK阻害薬BH-30236、そして前臨床段階のKRAS標的候補。
BLSM.products_services_ja: 開発中の低分子医薬品候補：BH-30643（EGFR阻害薬、臨床段階）、BH-30236（CLK阻害薬、臨床段階）、BH-501284（KRAS標的、前臨床段階）。

BRVE.description: Braveheart Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and other serious cardiovascular diseases, with its lead candidate BHB-1893, an oral small-molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor in development for obstructive and non-obstructive HCM. The company in-licensed BHB-1893 from Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals, whose trials it did not design, conduct, or oversee.
BRVE.products_services: BHB-1893, an investigational oral small-molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor (not yet approved), for obstructive and non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
BRVE.description_ja: Braveheart Bioは、肥大型心筋症などの重篤な心血管疾患向け治療薬を開発する臨床段階のバイオ医薬品企業。主力候補BHB-1893は、閉塞性および非閉塞性HCM向けに開発中の経口低分子心筋ミオシン阻害薬。同社はBHB-1893を江蘇恒瑞医薬からライセンス導入しており、同社の治験は設計・実施・監督していない。
BRVE.products_services_ja: BHB-1893：開発中の経口低分子心筋ミオシン阻害薬（未承認）、閉塞性・非閉塞性肥大型心筋症向け。

ATTO.description: Attovia Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation biotherapeutics for immune-mediated diseases, using its ATTOBODY biologics platform to design candidates such as ATTO-1310, an IL-31-targeting Fc-fusion protein being studied in patients with chronic pruritic diseases. Its pipeline also includes the bispecific ATTO-2306 (targeting IL-13 and IL-31) and the trispecific ATTO-1091 (targeting TL1A, IL-23 and integrin α4β7), both in earlier development.
ATTO.products_services: Clinical-stage biologic therapeutic candidates (ATTO-1310, ATTO-2306, ATTO-1091) discovered using the in-licensed ATTOBODY biparatopic biologics platform; no commercial products are described.
ATTO.description_ja: Attovia Therapeuticsは、次世代バイオ医薬品を用いて免疫介在性疾患の治療薬を開発する臨床段階のバイオ医薬品企業。ATTOBODYバイオロジクス基盤を用いて設計したATTO-1310（IL-31標的Fc融合タンパク質）を慢性掻痒性疾患患者で検討中。パイプラインには、初期開発段階の二重特異性抗体ATTO-2306（IL-13およびIL-31標的）と三重特異性抗体ATTO-1091（TL1A、IL-23、インテグリンα4β7標的）も含む。
ATTO.products_services_ja: 臨床段階のバイオ治療薬候補（ATTO-1310、ATTO-2306、ATTO-1091）。ライセンス導入したATTOBODY二重パラトープ・バイオロジクス基盤を用いて創出。記載された市販製品はなし。

ACCV.description: Accelevation Holdings Corp. is a vertically integrated infrastructure platform that designs, manufactures, and installs power distribution and white space infrastructure products for mission-critical data center environments serving hyperscale, colocation, AI, and cloud customers. The company offers integrated, factory-built solutions such as modular white space infrastructure (e.g., SkyBridge), structural and infrastructure products (e.g., TechFrame steel structures, conveyance systems, rack support), and turnkey field-built deployments.
ACCV.products_services: Integrated white space infrastructure solutions (modular factory-built and field-built), infrastructure products including steel structures, conveyance systems, rack and cabinet support, cabinet docking, caging/enclosure systems, and cable/fiber routing components, plus power distribution products, design, manufacturing, electrical scope, installation, and project coordination services.
ACCV.industry: Data center infrastructure (power distribution and white space construction/modular infrastructure for data centers)
ACCV.description_ja: Accelevation Holdings Corp.は、ハイパースケール、コロケーション、AI、クラウド顧客向けのミッションクリティカルなデータセンター環境のための配電およびホワイトスペース・インフラ製品を設計、製造、設置する垂直統合型インフラプラットフォーム。モジュール式ホワイトスペース・インフラ（例：SkyBridge）、構造・インフラ製品（例：TechFrame鉄骨構造、搬送システム、ラックサポート）、ターンキー型の現場施工による導入などの統合的な工場製作ソリューションを提供する。
ACCV.products_services_ja: 統合型ホワイトスペース・インフラソリューション（工場製作のモジュール型および現場施工型）、鉄骨構造、搬送システム、ラック・キャビネット支持、キャビネットドッキング、ケージング・筐体システム、ケーブル・光ファイバー配線部品などのインフラ製品、配電製品、設計、製造、電気工事範囲、設置およびプロジェクト調整サービス。

BBTX.description: Bambusa Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation, long-acting precision bispecific antibodies for immunology and inflammation, with a lead candidate BBT001 targeting IL-4Rα and IL-31 for atopic dermatitis and other inflammatory skin diseases. The company is advancing these candidates through clinical trials, including high-concentration subcutaneous formulations.
BBTX.products_services: Bispecific antibody product candidates (e.g., BBT001, BBT002, BBT003, BBT004) designed for high-concentration subcutaneous delivery; none are described as commercially approved products.
BBTX.description_ja: Bambusa Therapeuticsは、免疫学・炎症領域向けの次世代の長時間作用型精密二重特異性抗体を開発する臨床段階のバイオ医薬品企業。主力候補BBT001はIL-4RαとIL-31を標的とし、アトピー性皮膚炎などの炎症性皮膚疾患を対象とする。高濃度皮下投与製剤を含め、治験を通じて開発を進めている。
BBTX.products_services_ja: 二重特異性抗体の開発候補（例：BBT001、BBT002、BBT003、BBT004）。高濃度皮下投与向けに設計。いずれも市販承認製品として記載はなし。

GBC.description: Georgia Banking Company, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, operating through its bank subsidiary to serve businesses, professionals, entrepreneurs and consumers in the Atlanta MSA with approximately $3.3 billion in total assets across 10 full-service banking offices and three loan production offices. It emphasizes a relationship banking model combining local decision-making with the products and lending capacity of larger institutions.
GBC.products_services: Commercial banking, community banking, private banking, commercial real estate banking, mortgage warehouse and treasury services, plus lending, deposit and fee-generating businesses.
GBC.industry: Banking (bank holding company / commercial and community banking)
GBC.description_ja: Georgia Banking Company, Inc.は、ジョージア州アトランタに本社を置く銀行持株会社。銀行子会社を通じて、アトランタMSA地域の企業、専門職、起業家、個人顧客にサービスを提供し、総資産は約33億ドル、全面サービス型の店舗10か所と融資業務拠点3か所を運営。大手金融機関の商品と融資余力に、地域での意思決定力を組み合わせたリレーションシップバンキングを重視する。
GBC.products_services_ja: 商業銀行業務、地域銀行業務、プライベートバンキング、商業用不動産融資、モーゲージ・ウェアハウス融資およびトレジャリーサービス、融資、預金、手数料収入型の各種事業。

LYCA.description: Lycia Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapeutics that degrade disease-causing extracellular proteins using its proprietary LYTAC (Lysosomal Targeting Chimera) platform, with an initial focus on autoimmune, inflammatory and allergic diseases. Its lead programs include IgE-targeting degraders (LCA-0061, LCA-0062) for food allergy and other allergic diseases, and LCA-0321 for Graves' disease, all in clinical or preclinical development.
LYCA.products_services: Investigational LYTAC-based protein degrader therapeutic candidates (LCA-0061, LCA-0062, LCA-0321); no commercial products or services are described in the excerpt.
LYCA.description_ja: Lycia Therapeutics, Inc.は、独自のLYTAC（Lysosomal Targeting Chimera）プラットフォームを用いて、疾患の原因となる細胞外タンパク質を分解する治療薬を開発する臨床段階のバイオテクノロジー企業。自己免疫疾患、炎症性疾患、アレルギー疾患が当面の主な対象。主要プログラムは、食物アレルギーなどのアレルギー疾患を対象とするIgE標的分解薬（LCA-0061、LCA-0062）と、バセドウ病を対象とするLCA-0321で、いずれも臨床または前臨床開発段階。
LYCA.products_services_ja: LYTAC技術に基づく開発中のタンパク質分解治療薬候補（LCA-0061、LCA-0062、LCA-0321）。抜粋に記載された販売中の製品・サービスはなし。

DAVI.description: Davion Healthcare Plc is an Irish public limited company focused on developing and commercializing non-invasive, non-diagnostic home tests for early detection of potential health anomalies, including cancers. Its products (BreastCheck, FootFlow, Testic, and ThermaDerm) use thermography with liquid crystal film and AI analysis of smartphone images to flag areas that may warrant further clinical investigation.
DAVI.products_services: Four non-invasive home test kits: BreastCheck (breast tissue temperature anomalies), FootFlow (blood flow monitoring in feet and hands for diabetics), Testic (testicular temperature anomalies), and ThermaDerm (skin temperature monitoring across body locations).
DAVI.industry: Medical devices / home healthcare diagnostics (early detection and wellness monitoring)
DAVI.description_ja: Davion Healthcare Plc（アイルランドの株式公開有限会社）は、がんを含む潜在的な健康異常の早期発見を目的とした、非侵襲的かつ非診断目的の家庭用検査の開発・商業化に注力する企業。BreastCheck、FootFlow、Testic、ThermaDermの各製品は、液晶フィルムを用いたサーモグラフィーとスマートフォン画像のAI解析により、さらなる臨床検査が望ましい部位を検知する。
DAVI.products_services_ja: 非侵襲性の家庭用検査キット4種：BreastCheck（乳房組織の温度異常）、FootFlow（糖尿病患者向けの足と手の血流モニタリング）、Testic（精巣の温度異常）、ThermaDerm（全身各部位の皮膚温度モニタリング）。

CTY.description: City Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation RNA interference (RNAi) therapeutics that silence disease-relevant proteins, with a pipeline focused on thromboembolic diseases, Stargardt disease type 1, and anemia of chronic disease. The company uses its proprietary City Platform to discover and advance its product candidates, with its lead candidate CITY-FXI in early clinical development.
CTY.products_services: Investigational RNAi therapeutics (product candidates; no approved products are sold), including lead candidate CITY-FXI, developed via the City Platform
CTY.description_ja: City Therapeutics, Inc.は、疾患関連タンパク質を抑制する次世代RNA干渉（RNAi）治療薬を開発する臨床段階のバイオテクノロジー企業。血栓塞栓性疾患、スターガルト病1型、慢性疾患に伴う貧血を対象としたパイプラインを持つ。独自のCity Platformを用いて候補薬を探索・開発しており、主力候補のCITY-FXIは初期臨床開発段階にある。
CTY.products_services_ja: 開発中のRNAi治療薬候補（販売承認済みの製品はなし）。主力候補のCITY-FXIを含み、City Platformを通じて開発。

RTSN.description: Retension Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a company planning an initial public offering, as evidenced by its Form S-1 registration statement amendment filed solely to revise the filing fee exhibit. The excerpt does not describe the company's business, products, or operations.
RTSN.description_ja: Retension Pharmaceuticals, Inc.は、株式公開を計画している企業。Form S-1登録届出書の修正は、手数料の添付書類を改訂するためだけに提出されたもので、抜粋からは事業内容、製品、業務について確認できない。

TRXB.description: TRexBio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on tissue regulatory T cell (Treg) biology to discover and develop immunoregulatory medicines that restore immune balance and promote tissue repair in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Its lead candidates, TRB-061 (a TNFR2 agonist in a Phase 1a/b trial for atopic dermatitis) and TRB-071 (a CD30 agonist in IND-enabling studies for inflammatory bowel disease), are supported by its proprietary Deep Biology drug discovery platform.
TRXB.products_services: Investigational immunoregulatory drug candidates: TRB-061 (TNFR2 agonist) and TRB-071 (CD30/TNFRSF8 agonist), plus preclinical Treg-focused programs; no commercial products or services are described in the excerpt.
TRXB.industry: Biopharmaceuticals (clinical-stage drug development, immunology/autoimmune and inflammatory diseases)
TRXB.description_ja: TRexBioは、組織制御性T細胞（Treg）の生物学に注力する臨床段階のバイオファーマ企業。自己免疫疾患や炎症性疾患において免疫バランスの回復と組織修復を促す免疫調節薬の発見・開発を目指す。主力候補は、アトピー性皮膚炎を対象とする第1相試験中のTNFR2アゴニストTRB-061と、炎症性腸疾患を対象とし非臨床試験（IND申請前の試験）段階にあるCD30アゴニストTRB-071で、独自のDeep Biology創薬プラットフォームに支えられている。
TRXB.products_services_ja: 開発中の免疫調節薬候補：TRB-061（TNFR2アゴニスト）、TRB-071（CD30/TNFRSF8アゴニスト）、およびTreg関連の前臨床プログラム。抜粋に記載された販売中の製品・サービスはなし。

0002030771.description: QMSK Technology Co., Ltd is a Cayman Islands holding company that, through its PRC operating entities, provides business solutions to insurance industry enterprise customers, mainly auto insurance third-party service providers and insurers in China. It specializes in auto insurance aftermarket services, including insurance risk assessment and value-added services such as vehicle safety inspection and maintenance, supported by its proprietary Qingmin Service Platform (QMSP).
0002030771.products_services: Auto insurance aftermarket services, primarily insurance risk assessment and value-added services (vehicle safety inspection and vehicle maintenance), plus customized IT and promotional services on a case-by-case basis.
0002030771.description_ja: QMSK Technology Co., Ltd.は、中国本土の事業子会社を通じて保険業界の企業顧客にビジネスソリューションを提供する開曼諸島の持株会社。主に中国の自動車保険サードパーティサービス事業者および保険会社を対象とし、保険リスク評価や車両安全点検・整備などの付加価値サービスを含む自動車保険アフターマーケットサービスを、独自の清民サービスプラットフォーム(QMSP)を基盤に提供。
0002030771.products_services_ja: 自動車保険アフターマーケットサービス(主に保険リスク評価および車両安全点検・整備などの付加価値サービス)、ならびに案件ごとのカスタマイズされたITサービスおよびプロモーションサービス。

0001934387.description: CGL Logistics Holdings Ltd is planning an IPO, and this excerpt includes a table of contents and boilerplate prospectus language. The excerpt references freight forwarding logistics in China and Hong Kong, but does not explicitly describe the company's own business or products.
0001934387.industry: Freight forwarding logistics (inferred from a section heading referencing the freight forwarding logistics industry in China and Hong Kong)
0001934387.description_ja: CGL Logistics Holdings Ltd는 IPO를 계획하고 있으며, 이 발췌문에는 목차와 목론서의 일반 문구가 포함되어 있다. 중국과 홍콩의 화물 운송 주선 물류를 언급하지만, 회사 자체의 사업이나 제품은 명시적으로 설명하지 않는다.

0002095352.description: Tino Group Ltd is a Cayman Islands holding company that, through its Hong Kong operating subsidiary Tino Global Limited (founded 2008), provides immigration promotion and consulting services to the Asian market. It promotes investment-based immigration programs for institutional clients and offers personalized immigration consulting to individuals seeking international residency and citizenship.
0002095352.products_services: Immigration promotion services for investment-based immigration programs for institutional clients, and personalized immigration consulting services for individuals seeking international residency and citizenship.
0002095352.description_ja: Tino Group Ltd는 케이맨 제도의 지주회사로, 홍콩 영업 자회사 Tino Global Limited(2008년 설립)를 통해 아시아 시장에 이민 홍보 및 컨설팅 서비스를 제공한다. 기관 고객을 대상으로 투자 기반 이민 프로그램을 홍보하며, 해외 거주권과 시민권을 원하는 개인에게 맞춤형 이민 컨설팅을 제공한다.
0002095352.products_services_ja: 기관 고객을 위한 투자 기반 이민 프로그램 홍보 서비스, 해외 거주권 및 시민권을 원하는 개인을 위한 맞춤형 이민 컨설팅 서비스.

0002099952.description: Star Integratia Limited is a Cayman Islands holding company with no material operations of its own, conducting its business through its Singapore subsidiary All Best App Pte. Ltd. The excerpt does not describe the specific products or services the company sells.
0002099952.description_ja: Star Integratia Limited는 케이맨 제도의 지주회사로, 자체적인 중요 영업은 없으며 싱가포르 자회사 All Best App Pte. Ltd.를 통해 사업을 영위한다. 이 발췌문은 회사가 판매하는 구체적인 제품이나 서비스를 설명하지 않는다.

0002120528.description: Kainan Holding Group Ltd is a workforce and human resources management provider that sources, recruits, deploys and manages legally employed casual and skilled temporary workers for corporate customers in manufacturing, construction and service industries across Malaysia. Revenue is earned under service contracts, recognized over time based on confirmed worker attendance and hours at agreed workday rates.
0002120528.products_services: Workforce sourcing, recruitment, deployment and ongoing management of casual and skilled temporary workers, including onboarding, worker management and compliance support for corporate clients.
0002120528.industry: Human resources and workforce management (staffing/manpower services) in Malaysia
0002120528.description_ja: Kainan Holding Group Ltd는 말레이시아 내 제조, 건설 및 서비스 산업의 기업 고객을 위해 임시직 및 숙련 임시 근로자를 합법적으로 소싱, 채용, 배치 및 관리하는 인력 관리 제공업체다. 수익은 서비스 계약에 따라 발생하며, 확인된 근로자 출근 및 근로 시간과 합의된 일일 근로 단가를 기준으로 기간에 걸쳐 인식된다.
0002120528.products_services_ja: 임시직 및 숙련 임시 근로자의 소싱, 채용, 배치 및 지속적 관리. 기업 고객을 위한 온보딩, 근로자 관리 및 컴플라이언스 지원 포함.

PTT.description: Siyata PTT is a Cayman Islands exempted company and global developer of cellular-based communications solutions over 4G/LTE and 5G networks under the Siyata brands. Its products are rugged handheld mobile devices and in-vehicle communications solutions sold to first responders, military, enterprise customers, commercial fleets and industrial workers.
PTT.products_services: Rugged handheld cellular mobile devices and in-vehicle communications solutions
PTT.industry: Telecommunications equipment / cellular-based communications solutions for public safety and enterprise
PTT.description_ja: Siyata PTTは、ケイマン諸島法に基づく免税会社であり、Siyataブランドのもとで4G/LTEおよび5Gネットワーク上のセルラー方式の通信ソリューションを開発するグローバル企業である。頑丈なハンドヘルド型モバイル機器と車載通信ソリューションを、第一対応者、軍、法人顧客、商用車両群、産業従事者向けに販売している。
PTT.products_services_ja: 頑丈なハンドヘルド型セルラー・モバイル機器、車載通信ソリューション

RUIH.description: RUI Holdings Inc. operates through subsidiaries that provide integrated facility management and integrated transportation/logistics services, with operations in the Middle East (including the KSA and UAE) and PRC subsidiaries. The excerpt does not detail specific products or the full scope of its services beyond these general service areas.
RUIH.products_services: Integrated facility management and integrated transportation/logistics services
RUIH.industry: Integrated facility management and integrated transportation/logistics
RUIH.description_ja: RUI Holdings Inc.は、統合ファシリティマネジメントおよび統合輸送・物流サービスを提供する子会社を通じて事業を展開しており、中東（サウジアラビアおよびアラブ首長国連邦を含む）と中国の子会社を有する。抜粋からは、これらの一般的なサービス分野を超える具体的な製品や事業の全体像は分からない。
RUIH.products_services_ja: 統合ファシリティマネジメント、統合輸送・物流サービス

OCLT.description: OceanLight Acquisition Corp is a newly formed Cayman Islands blank check company (SPAC) with no operations, formed to effect a merger, share exchange, or similar business combination with one or more target businesses, with no specific target identified yet. Its IPO proceeds will be held in a U.S.-based trust account invested in U.S. treasuries or qualifying money market funds until a business combination is completed or the company liquidates.
OCLT.industry: Blank check companies (special purpose acquisition companies / SPACs)
OCLT.description_ja: OceanLight Acquisition Corpは、ケイマン諸島で新設された blank check 会社（SPAC）。事業運営はなく、1社以上の対象企業との合併、株式交換などの企業結合を目的とする。対象企業は未定。IPO調達資金は、企業結合の完了または清算まで、米国内の信託口座で米国債または適格マネー・マーケット・ファンドに運用される。

VVVV.description: vVARDIS Holding AG is a healthcare company whose proprietary peptide-enabled Curodont® platform is positioned as a clinically validated, drill-free treatment for early-stage cavities that aims to stop decay progression and repair enamel. Its flagship products, Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus (sold in the U.S. as an OTC drug) and Curodont® Repair (sold in other markets), generated $30.2 million in net revenue for 2025.
VVVV.products_services: Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus and Curodont® Repair, peptide-containing dental formulations for treating early-stage cavities (tooth decay).
VVVV.industry: Dental healthcare / dental products (oral care and restorative dentistry).
VVVV.description_ja: vVARDIS Holding AG はヘルスケア企業で、独自のペプチド技術を用いた Curodont® プラットフォームを展開する。初期段階のう蝕（虫歯）に対し、ドリルを使わずに、う蝕の進行を止め、エナメル質を修復することを狙う治療法として位置づけられ、臨床的な検証を謳う。主力製品の Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus（米国では OTC 医薬品として販売）と Curodont® Repair（その他の市場で販売）により、2025 年の純売上高は 3,020 万ドルだった。
VVVV.products_services_ja: Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus および Curodont® Repair。初期段階のう蝕（虫歯）の治療に用いるペプチド配合の歯科用製剤。

WWB.description: WINDWARD BIO GROUP AG is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing ultra-long-acting antibody medicines for serious respiratory and dermatologic diseases such as asthma, COPD, and atopic dermatitis. Its lead candidates, WIN378 (a TSLP-inhibiting monoclonal antibody) and WIN027 (a TSLP/IL-13 bispecific antibody), are designed for less frequent dosing than currently available biologic treatments.
WWB.products_services: Investigational ultra-long-acting monoclonal and bispecific antibody therapeutics (WIN378 and WIN027); no commercial products are described in the excerpt.
WWB.description_ja: WINDWARD BIO GROUP AGは、喘息、COPD、アトピー性皮膚炎などの重篤な呼吸器・皮膚疾患を対象とする超長時間作用型抗体医薬を開発する臨床段階のバイオテクノロジー企業。主要候補のWIN378（TSLP阻害モノクローナル抗体）およびWIN027（TSLP/IL-13二重特異性抗体）は、既存の生物学的製剤より投与頻度が少ないよう設計されている。
WWB.products_services_ja: 開発中の超長時間作用型モノクローナル抗体および二重特異性抗体医薬（WIN378およびWIN027）。抜粋内に商用製品の記載はない。

0002048740.description: EUROEV Holdings Ltd is a British Virgin Islands company that, upon closing of a pending business combination, will own Aiways Automobile Europe GmbH, which imports, distributes, and supports battery electric vehicles sourced from Chinese manufacturer Aiways Shangrao across 16 European countries. The company's distribution operations are currently largely shut down due to suspended manufacturing by its supplier, and it is planning to restart through European assembly and new suppliers.
0002048740.products_services: Battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and related aftersales support, parts, and customer relationship management, plus a technical center in Munich for adapting vehicles to European standards.
0002048740.industry: Automotive – electric vehicle import, distribution, and aftersales services in Europe
0002048740.description_ja: EUROEV Holdings Ltd。英領バージン諸島の会社で、係属中の企業結合の完了時に、Aiways Automobile Europe GmbHを保有する。同社は中国メーカーAiways Shangrao製の電気自動車（BEV）を欧州16カ国で輸入・販売・サポートしている。供給元の製造停止により販売事業は現在ほぼ停止しており、欧州内組立や新規サプライヤーにより再開を計画している。
0002048740.products_services_ja: 電気自動車（BEV）および関連のアフターセールス、部品、顧客関係管理。欧州基準への適合を行うミュンヘンの技術センターも運営。

TRCX.description: Tracx Logis Ltd. is a technology-driven, integrated cross-border logistics services provider operating e-Commerce Logistics and Enterprise Logistics businesses, using an asset-light model and its proprietary TLPS platform with AI to offer shipping, storage, and fulfillment services primarily across Asia and globally. The company also offers AI-driven e-commerce tools such as Smart AI Studio, which helps merchants create product pages and advertising content and publish them to integrated e-commerce platforms.
TRCX.products_services: Cross-border e-commerce logistics (end-to-end shipping, storage, distribution, and fulfillment), enterprise logistics services, the TLPS platform with Smart Warehouse and inventory management modules, AI customer service tools, and Smart AI Studio/tFit for e-commerce merchants and sellers.
TRCX.industry: Logistics and freight services, with a technology focus on cross-border e-commerce logistics and AI-enabled e-commerce tools
TRCX.description_ja: Tracx Logis Ltd.は、技術主導型の統合型越境ロジスティクスサービス事業者。e-Commerceロジスティクス事業とEnterpriseロジスティクス事業を展開し、アセットライト型のモデルと独自のAI搭載プラットフォームTLPSを活用して、主にアジアおよびグローバルで輸送、保管、フルフィルメントサービスを提供。さらに、Smart AI Studioなどおよび AI駆動型のEコマースツールも提供し、販売者が商品ページや広告コンテンツを作成し、連携先のECプラットフォームへ公開することを支援。
TRCX.products_services_ja: 越境Eコマースロジスティクス（エンドツーエンドの輸送、保管、配送、フルフィルメント）、エンタープライズロジスティクスサービス、Smart WarehouseおよびInventory管理モジュールを備えたTLPSプラットフォーム、AIカスタマーサービスツール、Eコマース販売者向けのSmart AI Studio／tFit。
